say:1:1441106001:1.source_cn: 主人，满满从湖边带了好吃的回来！

say:2:1441106002:1.text: Look at these huge red berries! Chippy's got a bagful of them!
say:2:1441106002:1.source_cn: 是又大又红的野果，满满把包都塞满了！

say:3:1441106003:1.text: Lots of dwarves are chilling by the lake, enjoying fruits and fine brew. Chippy picked some wild berries there...
say:3:1441106003:1.source_cn: 湖边很多矮人带着水果和啤酒在野餐呢，看起来真惬意。满满...

say:4:1441106004:1.text: Hold on, Chippy! These berries don't look safe to eat...
say:4:1441106004:1.source_cn: 满满，这些果子好像不能吃……别往嘴里塞啊！

say:5:1441106005:1.text: Magister, how about we check out the lake? Maybe we can fish there?
say:5:1441106005:1.source_cn: 不过有湖的话，是不是可以钓鱼呢？主人，我们去看看吧！
say:5:1441106005:1.male: Magister, how about we check out the lake? Maybe we can fish there?
say:5:1441106005:1.female: Magister, how about we check out the lake? Maybe we can fish there?
